edits.old: Then the boundary test fails the build
edits.new:
Then the boundary test fails the build

  Scenario: AC4 Business rules (section 8 BR1 to BR10; new, no legacy AC)
    Given the rules of section 8 apply to this service
    When the story is built and tested
    Then each rule BR1 to BR10 is covered by a criterion of section 7 or by a guardrail or boundary test named in section 16

  Scenario: AC5 Error answers (sections 7 and 16; new, no legacy AC)
    Given a provided operation of this service is called
    When the caller sends no login, lacks the Litigation right, or names a legal action outside its scope
    Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404 respectively and carries the error envelope
    Then no decision record and no row changes

  Scenario: AC6 Replay of a write (sections 7 and 16; new, no legacy AC)
    Given a write of this service has been accepted under an Idempotency-Key
    When the same request is replayed with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the replay returns the first answer and no second hearing, decision record or timer is written

  Scenario: AC7 Activity retry and timeout (sections 7 and 16; new, no legacy AC)
    Given an activity of `LitigationWorkflow` fails or times out
    When the activity is retried
    Then no second decision record, hearing or timer is written for the same action

  Scenario: AC8 Consumed call fails (sections 7 and 16; new, no legacy AC)
    Given a consumed contract call fails or does not answer
    When the calendar is read or the step runs
    Then the answer comes from this service's own rows, the stale marker of MSG-P1-001 is shown and no hearing is blocked
